description: React component for displaying and managing user appointments, including fetching data, canceling appointments, and handling payments via Razorpay and Stripe.

methods.name: slotDateFormat
methods.description: Formats a date string from 'DD_MM_YYYY' to 'DD Mon YYYY'.

methods.name: getUserAppointments
methods.description: Fetches user appointments from the API and updates state.

methods.name: cancelAppointment
methods.description: Cancels an appointment via API call.

methods.name: initPay
methods.description: Initializes Razorpay payment with provided order details.

methods.name: appointmentRazorpay
methods.description: Handles Razorpay payment process for an appointment.

methods.name: appointmentStripe
methods.description: Handles Stripe payment process for an appointment.
